messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T is $799, Batch 6, ships Nov 21 2026; at under 12¢ its power runs roughly $20–25 a month.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Magic Miner 40T at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T at 10¢: ~57,500 sats/month (~$48), power ~$47/month, block odds ~0.22% a year. $799, ships Nov 21.
Nice, a first miner. At about ten cents, the 40T costs around forty-seven dollars a month to run. Where would it go, garage or inside?
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is 650 W with active fans — audible on a desk. Quieter desk options: NerdOctaxe 12 TH/s $359.99 or NerdQaxe++ 6 TH/s $249, both in stock.
It'd stack about fifty-seven thousand sats a month for around forty-seven dollars of power. Heads up though, at six-fifty watts it runs warm and loud for a desk. Would a spare room work?
Looked up for Sarah: Spare room is fine. Closing facts: $799, Batch 6 ships Nov 21 2026, $40 flat shipping at its 15 lb weight.

A spare room works well for it. You'd get a shot at a full block every ten minutes, about a 0.22 percent chance a year, and you learn Bitcoin hands-on. Want to grab one? (The call ended. 3 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
